markets.rules_primary: If the Republican Party wins the 2026 gubernatorial election in Nebraska by 1 percentage point or more, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The margin of victory shall be calculated as follows based on the margin type.

For percentage points: the vote percentage received by the Republican Party minus the vote percentage received by the candidate/party/option that finishes immediately behind the Republican Party if the Republican Party wins, or the candidate/party that finishes first if the Republican Party loses.

Each margin range is inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound. No rounding shall be applied to the calculated margin. For example, for consecutive ranges of 5-6% and 6-7%, a margin of 5.99999% resolves within the 5-6% range, while a margin of exactly 6% resolves within the 6-7% range. If the Republican Party runs under multiple parties or is listed multiple times, votes attributable to the same underlying Republican Party will be summed.

If the Republican Party wins the election, the margin will be positive. If the Republican Party loses the election, the margin will be negative. If the Republican Party ties for first place, the margin shall be 0. For uncontested races where the Republican Party is the only candidate, the margin shall be 100 percentage points or the total number of votes cast (for raw votes).

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a person formally takes office as Minister of National Security as a result of the government formation following the 2026 Israeli legislative election.
markets.rules_primary: If Amichai Eliyahu formally takes office as Minister of National Security as a result of the government formation following the 2026 Israeli legislative election before Oct 27, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only the first person to formally take office as Minister of National Security in the government formed after the 2026 Israeli legislative election, when it takes office or within 30 days after its first ministers are appointed, counts. An incumbent reappointed to the post counts; later reshuffles, rotations and appointments do not. Nominations, coalition agreements and announcements do not count, nor do acting, caretaker or interim service or a head of government holding the portfolio only by default while it is unassigned. If the ministry is renamed or restructured, such as back to the Ministry of Public Security, the minister of a successor ministry with substantially the same responsibilities counts.

An office under a different name counts as Alternate Prime Minister if, as part of that government's formation, its holder is given a binding right under law or under an arrangement approved in the Knesset confidence vote to become Prime Minister later in the same government's term (a rotation), without a new confidence vote. markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If an under-16 social media ban has become law in New Zealand before Oct 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, an “under-16 social media ban” means a legally binding national measure that prohibits people under 16 from holding or accessing accounts on a class of social media platforms, or requires those platforms to prevent people under 16 from holding or accessing such accounts.

A measure that only requires age assurance, child-safety risk assessments, parental consent, or other safeguards, without prohibiting under-16 accounts or access, does NOT qualify. The measure may include additional provisions and may use any legislative vehicle.

Enactment is measured when the measure receives Royal assent and becomes law, not when its substantive restrictions commence or begin being enforced.
markets.title: Will an under-16 social media ban become law in New Zealand before Oct 1, 2027?

events.title: Will New Zealand enact an under-16 social media ban?

The ruling must:
Be issued by the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit in DIRECTV, LLC v. Nexstar Media Group, Inc., No. 26-2490, or in a consolidated or related appeal from the same District Court case
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

Affirmance of the preliminary injunction in full
Any order of the District Court, including the preliminary injunction entered April 17, 2026, the orders of August 6, 2026, and any later modification the District Court makes to its own injunction
An order granting, denying, or dissolving a stay pending appeal
Dismissal or withdrawal of the appeal, including after a settlement
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Administrative or scheduling orders

custom_strike.Option: the candidate of the registered coalition that includes PAN

markets.rules_primary: If the candidate of the registered coalition that includes PAN wins the 2027 Mérida mayoral election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A candidate's coalition is the coalition or candidatura común that registered the candidate with the Instituto Electoral y de Participación Ciudadana de Yucatán, and a party running alone is a coalition of one.
Coalition membership is fixed at registration; later changes do not move a candidate.
A coalition that includes more than one of PAN, Morena and MC counts only for the first of them in that order.
PAN is Partido Acción Nacional, Morena is Movimiento Regeneración Nacional, MC is Movimiento Ciudadano.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If total precipitation at Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (LFPG) for The Weather Company reporting day dated September 3, 2027 (06:00 UTC that date to 06:00 UTC the following date) is strictly greater than 0 millimeters, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses The Weather Company's daily precipitation value for Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (LFPG), labeled September 3, 2027, in millimeters. The source's reporting day runs from 06:00 UTC on the report date to 06:00 UTC the following date. Use the date label on the daily report.

Data is available at https://weather.com/kalshi under International, Paris (LFPG), for the report date. Use the daily precipitation total, not hourly temperature observations or a weather forecast. The Weather Company attributes this precipitation data to Météo-France, API Données Climatologiques (https://portail-api.meteofrance.fr).

Total precipitation includes liquid-equivalent rainfall and melted frozen precipitation. Trace amounts and missing daily values count as 0.00 millimeters, subject to the contract's data-error and contingency provisions. Use the initial non-preliminary reported value, subject to the contract's material-error correction provisions. A Final label alone does not establish that data is error-free. If no reliable data is available by expiration, the contract's last-fair-price provision applies.

Trading is scheduled to close one minute before the reporting day ends. Expiration is at 10:00 AM ET on the specified expiration date, subject to the contract's early-expiration and contingency provisions.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Weather Company or Météo-France. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners. Météo-France does not endorse this product.
